name: FlixBus
adresse:
Flix SE
Friedenheimer Brücke 16
80639 Munich
Germany
infobox: FlixBus is a long-distance coach operator with a Europe-wide scheduled network, connecting cities in Germany with numerous destinations across Europe. For scheduled journeys over 250 km, UK passenger rights apply (under The Bus and Coach Passengers Rights Regulations 2013 / retained EU Regulation 181/2011): In the event of cancellation, overbooking, or a departure delay of more than 120 minutes, you can choose between continuing your journey or a full refund of the ticket price. If this choice is not offered, you are entitled to compensation of 50% of the ticket price. The operating company Flix SE is based in Munich; complaints should be submitted within three months of the journey. For care services such as meals and hotels, limits apply up to two nights and £80/€80 per night.
